title: Hikers who vanish near the alien bases are killed or kept as workers
place_text: Mount Nyangani, Zimbabwe; Mount Zeil, Australia

tellings.quote: You see too much. You disappear.

plain: Hikers who go missing near Mount Nyangani in Zimbabwe and Mount Zeil in Australia, places he links to alien bases, are either killed or kept on as workers. An Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan puts it bluntly: 'You see too much. You disappear.' If true, it would mean those disappearances are not accidents.
